underlying_goal.description: What the user fundamentally wanted to achieve in this session.

brief_summary.description: One sentence: what the user wanted and whether they got it.

friction_incidents.description: Discrete friction incidents. EMPTY ARRAY when the session had no friction.

one_line.description: The specific incident in one sentence.

evidence_quote.description: A short VERBATIM substring copied from the transcript that demonstrates the incident. Omit if no exact quote supports it.

file.description: Path the incident concerns, if applicable.

standing_preferences.description: Durable rules the user stated about HOW Claude should work (working style, conventions, process) — reusable across sessions, NOT one-off task steps. EMPTY ARRAY when the user stated none (the common case).

rule.description: The reusable working-preference, phrased as a standing rule.

evidence_quote.description: VERBATIM substring of the user's own words stating it. Required — if you cannot quote the user stating it, do not include it.

scope.description: Optional: where it applies (a repo/package/area), if the user scoped it; omit if general.
